translation: In wind warmth the lung first receives the pathogen and then transmits retrograde into the pericardium; one treats the upper burner, not by the same method as clearing the stomach and attacking downward. Pediatrics, not knowing this, first uses dispersing and digestives; when these fail, switches to Chai, Qin, Gualou, Zhishi, and Huanglian; then uses downward seizure; and when these fail, many become critical. All because they do not understand disease of the hand channels.
If cold phlegm blocks and closes, there is also urgent wheezing and a raised chest; one cannot use the previous method, but should induce vomiting with Sanbai or use Miaoxiang Wan.

Summer gives rise to heat disease, but before the summer solstice the seasonal qi is not yet greatly hot. The Classic calls disease before the summer solstice warmth, and disease after the summer solstice summerheat.
